mantra.line: Everything ORANGE built since 9/3 was built for this. The only thing missing is one word, and it has been missing for a week.
One decision, D-9, gates seven. Rule it and the design pass runs the same session.
A NO-GO is a legal answer and ends the stall as cleanly as a GO. An undated hold is the one answer the flow forbids.

frago.mission: Stand up a paying creative operation on what is already in hand, **in order to** convert the unemployment window into the studio's founding season. (Intent drafted 9/3 for your wording, D-10.)
frago.order: **Rule the twelve appearance calls, then sculpt.** The macro block is five minutes of panel work with the values already chosen; the twelve calls are hair, eyes, skin tone, marks, makeup and the rest — the things that make her a specific person instead of a default. Say "take the twelve" to take them all as written.
frago.default: Silence: the redrafted §1 sentence stands; the library banks at twenty until the nut figure says forty; the sex-menu sign-off and the W7 platform pick run on the lane as ruled.

calls.options: GO (staged: no-dependency items now, the rest as their gates clear) · HOLD to a date · NO-GO (park with the AAR; the bible and the library stay as assets)
calls.ruling: RULED 2026-09-16, Chief: "rule D9 go." GO, staged clear. The undated hold ended after twelve days and five boards.

calls.q: D-5 · the nut and the runway
calls.options: your number: months of runway without income. Nine to twelve → run as briefed; four to eight → first-dollar-first plus a part-time search; under four → compress or park
calls.ruling: RULED 2026-09-16, Chief: "D5 go." Provisional. The structure as asked: the nut as a range, runway = liquid ÷ nut, the backstop its own line; the number itself is Chief's and goes in the gates table §1. Read off the record (unemployed 9/3, $0 base, backstop), runway is treated as under four months → first-dollar-first: the slice sells at Gate 3, the launch library compresses to twenty plus sixty days, the income search runs in parallel. The number is the one thing that moves the branch.

calls.options: yes, a disclosed 3D persona is the believability bar · no, another frame
calls.ruling: RULED 2026-09-16, Chief: "D6 yes." A disclosed 3D persona is the believability bar. The COA's first open question closed with it.

calls.options: who, and the year; cause matters more than year for the spine
calls.ruling: RULED 2026-09-16, Chief: "D7 go." The recommendation as written: mother is the loss · 2020 · overdose · she is 15. Dad alive, the eviction at 18 in 2023. Anniversary month stays open as a content-calendar lever; the death date is a transit pick once the natal chart is fixed. Unlocks the second half of the character sheet.

calls.options: confirm: a fresh X account plus bookmarks, five core, twenty-five wide, pulled at zero cost
calls.ruling: RULED 2026-09-23, Chief: "8 confirm." The method is confirmed as written — one fresh X account, bookmarks only, five core seats plus twenty-five wide, at zero cost, pulled by hand over thirty days. Three of the five core seats are already filled (itsmemphishxe · Sulbas3D and 3DessJeez · Kirenes and Variety Itsol). Seat 3 (Fanvue) stays a flagged risk with its stated fallback: try by hand once, leave the seat open if the pull fails. **Schedule note: started 9/23 the pull lands about 10/23, inside the Gate 3 evenings window, so it costs no critical-path time.**

calls.options: word the one sentence in §1 yourself
calls.default: the draft stands until you do
calls.ruling: **RULED 2026-09-23, Chief: "D-10 will also take it."** The redraft stands as the charter's §1 sentence: **"Stand up a paying creative operation on what is already in hand, in order to build a studio that keeps going on its own work — with or without a job, and past its first signing."** It replaces the 9/3 draft, which had read the purpose as converting the unemployment window into a founding season — a purpose Chief ruled false the same day (a job landing changes nothing; Ultrasin is the point; success is a thing that exists and keeps going). **The consequence stands with it: durability outranks speed in every trade-off from here, so where first-dollar-first and a bankable library disagree, the library wins unless the nut figure says otherwise.** Brief v0.1 becomes v1.0 with this line; M-002 closes.

calls.options: where her content sits relative to the funnel's lane; framing that processors and platforms ban downstream gates the platform pick
calls.ruling: **RULED 2026-09-23, Chief: "D-11 B, the recommended." Position B — funnel-adjacent: her channel, her frame.** The category runs on her own paid tier in her own bratty register; ULTRA DARK reposts non-explicit teaser stills the way it reposts anyone's, credits and links out, and keeps its no-money rule. The framing stays hers, so the Degradation soft limit never converts. Chosen on durability: no ban in the fifteen cases ever attached to the category itself, and no platform or processor in the policy read bans it by name — the bans land on framing and on extremity, both of which her locked hard limits already avoid. **Flip condition on the record: a platform strike or processor flag on the category rather than the framing moves the call to C or D.** Unblocks the sex-menu sign-off (§9 call 7) and the W7 platform pick.

calls.options: January 2027 (the boresight's recommendation) · February 2027 · December 2026 · later
calls.ruling: RULED 2026-09-23, Chief spoken: **February 2027.** One month later than BORESIGHT 24's recommendation. The back-plan puts the extra month into library-banking rather than a second test month or a later start, because Gate 3's evenings have not begun. Nineteen days idle, four boards and the leverage line on every one of them; the line now reads 'Back-plan February 2027.'

calls.options: the one figure the back-plan could not derive: evenings per week Chief can actually sustain against the parallel income search
calls.ruling: RULED 2026-09-23, Chief: "I should be able to sustain, like, five, six nights a week." The back-plan's last stated unknown is closed. The arithmetic on 100 evenings against 19 weeks: **6/week = 16.7 weeks, margin +2.3 weeks · 5.5/week = 18.2 weeks, margin +0.8 · 5/week = 20 weeks, margin −1.0.** February survives at six and slips at five, so six is the planning rate and five is the warning line, not the floor.

**RULED 2026-09-23, Chief: "if Fansly bans photoreal, then let's totally do stylized."** Stylized it is, and the policy read backs it: Fansly bans photoreal AI, Patreon allows stylized AI and bans hyperrealistic, TikTok and YouTube auto-label photoreal. Stylized widens the platform set instead of narrowing it. **Style reference named by Chief: Sakimichan** — the painted, semi-realistic pinup register, cited off the KDA set. Held to the same rule the reference accounts run under: **a register to aim at, never a clone**; the look is derived, not copied, and no output should be presentable as that artist's work.

calls.options: the back-plan's conservative floor (20 pieces + 60 days) · the beat sheet's Season 1 requirement (28 launch + 10 buffer = 38) · the ceiling (40 + 90 days)
calls.ruling: **RESOLVED 2026-09-23 by the nut, not by a fresh decision.** D-5's structure was already ruled — under four months of runway compresses the library — and Chief's figures confirm a short runway. **The library banks at the floor: twenty pieces plus a sixty-day buffer.** This overrides the 28 + 10 recommendation written earlier the same day, which was made on durability grounds while the nut was still unknown. It saves about 72 evenings and is the difference between a plan that fits the 19 weeks and one that does not. Durability still governs everything the money does not; here the money governs.

calls.q: L-2 · the explicit / suggestive / SFW split
calls.options: the beat sheet's 45 / 35 / 20 · a lewd-first weighting · something else
calls.default: 45 / 35 / 20 with the explicit share behind the paid tier (rec)
calls.ruling: **Recommended: keep 45 / 35 / 20 as the library's composition, but read it against D-18's lewd-first ruling for what goes where.** The 45 percent explicit is the paid tier's inventory; the public feed runs on the 35 suggestive and 20 SFW, which is what keeps Instagram and TikTok reach alive and the processors uninterested. The split is a mix ratio, not a posting ratio — those were being conflated.

calls.options: confirm Set 4 as the test · a different set · a different test
calls.default: confirm Set 4, with the bar rewritten to stylized (rec)
calls.ruling: **Recommended: Set 4 stays the test, but D-17 changed what passing means.** The AAR's row 1 asks whether the skin reads natural against the DARKROOM pull at arm's length — a photorealism check, and the ruling on 9/23 was stylized. The rewritten bar: does the render read as a deliberate painted style in the Sakimichan register, rather than as a failed attempt at real? Same set, same evening, different pass condition — and the COA B skin-shader spend that hung off the old row probably falls away with it.

**The back-plan is drawn and it is tight.** About 19 weeks to February; the critical path — Gate 3's evenings, the posting week, the AAR, then banking — costs roughly 100 evenings on the conservative figures, which is five to six evenings a week with no gap longer than the AAR week. phases.t: **Boresight walked** over four transmissions; PIRs answered; holdings mapped.
**The brief ruled** — D-9 cleared GO 9/16, staged. D-10 still drafted, not worded; the draft stands.

**The design set** — benchmark read · Blender COA · reference-pull spec · the character sheet v0.2 (name + chart ruled) · the Season 1 beat sheet + shoot list (8 sets / 38 stills) · **the gates table with the nut as a range (D-5, provisional) · attainability stated.** Gate 2 passed on the provisional number; Chief's figure re-reads it.

**The vertical slice** — opened 9/16 ("slice go"): Blender 4.5 LTS · MPFB2 · the CC0 assets · HDRIs · the DARKROOM pull · the scaffold script · S4-01 rendered as a stand-in. **The back-plan of 9/23 dates it: the 15–20 evenings run in October 2026, 0 done as of 9/23.** The chain is sculpt → skin (the test row) → hair → pose → dressing → render, then the posting week and the five-row AAR. AAR row 1 (skin at 100% against the DARKROOM pull) is the row that gates the gate.

**Launch** — library banked (the back-plan runs the conservative floor: 20 pieces plus a 60-day buffer), accounts live, Season 1 begins. **Dated 9/23: banking runs December and January at up to four evenings a still, launch lands February 2027.** The 40-piece ceiling only applies if the October test clears its top threshold.
**Monthly gates** for three months; first on-target month.
**Exit threshold or kill criterion**; AAR; the Season 2 decision.

coord: Workstreams: W1 character · W2 season · W3 studio frame · W4 look · W5 pipeline · W6 numbers · W7 distribution.
Out of scope: video, live streaming, any real-performer content, spend beyond the stretch, undisclosed passing as human, anyone under 18 in canon or render.
Deny list: ACTUAL's identity, location, employer history, finances; the real reference accounts' identities (composite, never clone); the studio's internal tooling; anything under _PRIVATE/.
Disruptions planned: platform action → second platform live from day one plus an owned hub; discovery throttle → SFW funnel account.

items.t: **The 30-day reference pull is live (D-8 confirmed).** One fresh X account, bookmarks only, five core seats and twenty-five wide, by hand, zero cost. It runs alongside the Gate 3 evenings and feeds the posting grammar that Season 1 needs at launch.
**The sex-menu sign-off and the W7 platform pick are released.** Both were held behind the lane; the lane is ruled. The sign-off is §9 call 7 on the character sheet; W7 feeds D-13's platform set.

**The Gate 3 AAR row 1 is now the wrong test.** It asks whether S4-01's skin reads natural against the DARKROOM pull at arm's length — a photorealism check. Under a stylized ruling the question becomes whether the render reads as a deliberate painted style rather than a failed real one, which is a different pass condition and a different failure mode. **Rewrite row 1 before the skin evening.**

**The sculpt has no physical brief.** The character sheet is twelve layers of psychology, chart and register; its L2 line — "presentation is direct, armored, coiled, reads as a dare" — is a register, not a face. There is no face shape, no build, no height, no hair anywhere in it. The slice order sends the sculpt at "the character sheet's register", which cannot be sculpted against. **The spec is one short evening: the L2b morphology chain (SKELETON → MUSCLE → FAT → CONDITION) from BOLO 43, the sixteen Set 4 thumbs in `refs/set4/`, and Sakimichan's register as the stylized target.**

**The spec closed the gap it found.** Two findings came out of building it and both are on the record: **the L2b morphology system is body-only — it has no facial layer at all**, so the face runs on the Sakimichan register instead; and **MPFB2's exact face-target names could not be verified from disk**, so the face section gives regions and directions to read off the panel labels rather than names to type blind. The macro slider names and ranges were verified and are safe to set.

items.t: **Six evenings a week is the planning rate (RULED 9/23).** The margin is 2.3 weeks at six and negative at five, so the difference between the two is the difference between February and March. The income search competes for the same nights and no figure exists for it yet — that is the one number still missing from the plan.

**The COA B skin-shader spend ($120–150) may now be unnecessary.** It was the trigger attached to failing the photoreal skin row. A stylized target does not need a photoreal skin bundle, so the stretch budget probably stays unspent — confirm at the AAR rather than before it.

**The stretch budget is effectively zero** and the income search competes with the six evenings for the same nights. That competition is the plan's largest unquantified risk — no hours-per-week figure exists for it.

**The rewritten Gate 3 skin row is four yes/no checks**, not a judgement call: suppressed micro-texture with soft falloff · a rim pass visibly distinct from the key · exaggeration below the neck while the face stays legible · pastel-plus-accent rather than full-gamut colour. Four yeses clears it. That replaces "does she read natural at arm's length", which the stylized ruling made the wrong question.
